title: Art, Health, and Training
summary: Art and street art, medical care, routines, training, and institutions.
whyItMatters: Art, healthcare, and training all involve institutions, processes, professional roles, and ways to describe how something is created, treated, or practiced.

mentalModel.title: Identify field, process, and participant
mentalModel.content: Ask what activity occurs, which institution supports it, and who performs or receives the action.

mentalModel.title: Move from observation to interpretation
mentalModel.content: Describe visible or factual details before explaining effect, purpose, or personal response.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe art through medium and effect
ruleBlocks.content: Use Werk, Künstler, Ausstellung, Motiv, Material, Wirkung, and öffentlich zugänglich.

ruleBlocks.title: Map the care process
ruleBlocks.content: Connect symptoms, examination, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, and recovery.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe a sustainable routine
ruleBlocks.content: State goal, frequency, intensity, technique, rest, and progress.

ruleBlocks.title: Name institutional roles
ruleBlocks.content: Distinguish clinic, practice, museum, gallery, club, and training center.

sentenceStructure: Separate professional information from personal interpretation.
Connect routine to goal and result.

comparisons.summary: Institutional and process descriptions naturally foreground actions and results through passive voice.
The communication lesson organizes description, interpretation, and summary.

examples.de: Das Wandbild wurde von einer lokalen Künstlerin gestaltet.
examples.en: The mural was created by a local artist.

examples.de: In der Ausstellung werden Werke aus verschiedenen Materialien gezeigt.
examples.en: Works made from different materials are shown in the exhibition.

examples.de: Nach der Untersuchung wird eine passende Behandlung empfohlen.
examples.en: After the examination, a suitable treatment is recommended.

examples.de: Ein guter Trainingsplan enthält Belastung und ausreichend Erholung.
examples.en: A good training plan includes exertion and sufficient recovery.

examples.de: Regelmäßiges Training kann Beweglichkeit und Kraft verbessern.
examples.en: Regular training can improve mobility and strength.

commonMistakes.wrong: Present an interpretation as the only fact.
commonMistakes.correct: Describe evidence and mark the interpretation as a viewpoint.

commonMistakes.wrong: Treat general language as personal medical advice.
commonMistakes.correct: Use the vocabulary to describe care and refer individual decisions to professionals.

commonMistakes.wrong: Equate more intensity with better training.
commonMistakes.reason: Sustainable training balances load and rest.

tips: Describe one artwork without evaluating it first.
Map a care process from appointment to follow-up.
Explain a weekly training routine and its goal.
